changes: First Release of CrossFlow for Windows and Mac - Adobe Premiere Pro from 13.0 CC 2019 - DaVinci Resolve Studio from 20.0
CrossFlow does not work with the Free DaVinci Resolve standard version
Supported while converting your Premiere Pro Project to DaVinci Resolve:
Multiple Timelines with different Framerates or Resolutions
Different Timeline Audio Tracks Config (Mono, Stereo, 5.1, ..)
Timeline Clip Opacity, Motion Params (Scale, Position, Rotation, AnchorPoint, Blend Mode), Audio Volume and Pan
Timeline Clip Speed Changed and/or Reversed
